title: Reject unsafe recovery while retaining valid no-change paths

rubric.text: Permits only A after exact verified committed equivalence and acknowledged renewal; preserves historical marker payload/digest, predecessor provenance, owners/artifacts and unchanged grants. Does not treat renewal as a parked-CI recovery signal.
Stops semantic/unknown/uncommitted B–D cases and reconciles ambiguous publication; same ID or runner-authored text alone is insufficient, and a still-active old-lease writer prevents renewal.

E detects missing provider capability and retains full-replan fallback; F uses provider-owned verified effective contract with the same owner, In-progress slot and affected final-head evidence, without defining a controller-owned amendment format.

G cannot use amendment as an escape hatch: unknown or stale evidence blocks dependent work; material architecture requires full review/replan, changed authority requires stakeholder/source decision; grants and qualification remain intact.
H preserves the screened non-overlapping/current-plan/no-op path, reuses only uninvalidated complete state with fresh write checks, and keeps next single-ticket without mutations or merge.
